answer.reason: The only verse about Moab the son of Lot (GEN 19:37) says no more than the summary does, and the other marked verses concern the land or nation of Moab.
doubts: GEN 36:35 mentions the field of Moab, a place, so it was left out.
2CH 20:10, 2CH 20:22 and 2CH 20:23 speak of the nation of Moab in Jehoshaphat's day, not the son of Lot, so they were left out.
